text: 四十岁的年纪，正是我们人到中年的时候，人生已经过去了大半，在这许多年里，我们经历过种种事情，见证了人情冷暖，慢慢的，许多事情我们也渐渐看透看清。
en: At forty years of age, we are precisely at middle age; life has already passed its greater part. Through these many years we have experienced all sorts of things, witnessed the warmth and coldness of human relationships, and slowly we have come to see through and understand many matters.

text: 人到中年，我们才意识到身体的重要性，以前年轻的时候，我们还不知道身体的宝贵，抽烟喝酒熬夜，为了工作和应酬，我们经常食无定时。
en: Only when we reach middle age do we realise the importance of our health. When we were young before, we did not yet know the preciousness of our bodies; we smoked, drank and stayed up late, and for the sake of work and social engagements we often ate at irregular times.

text: 随着年纪的增长，身体的各种病痛也越来越多，我们才明白赚钱再多都不如身体重要。
en: As we grow older, various ailments of the body become ever more numerous, and we come to understand that no matter how much money we earn, it cannot compare to the importance of our health.

text: 以前，我们把一些事情看得非常重要，年轻的时候，我们总想着打拼出一片自己的天地，发展自己的事业，让家人过上更好的生活，到后来我们才明白，只要一家人平安健康，就已经是最大的幸福。
en: Before, we regarded certain things as very important. When we were young we always thought of carving out a place of our own, developing our own careers, and letting our families live a better life. Only later did we realise that as long as the family is safe and healthy, that is already the greatest happiness.

text: 年轻的时候，我们以为认识的朋友越多越好，我们以为人际关系越广，以后做什么事情都能获得朋友的帮助，可是现实告诉我们错了，很多时候和你只是表面兄弟，内心只不过是逢场作戏罢了。
en: When we were young, we thought the more friends we knew the better; we thought the wider our web of relationships, the more we could gain friends' help in whatever we did. But reality told us we were wrong — in many cases those with you are merely brothers on the surface, and in their hearts it is nothing but playing along for the occasion.

text: 当你荣华富贵的时候，身边个个都是你的朋友，不管你做什么事情，都有人帮你解决。
en: When you are prosperous and honoured, everyone around you is your friend, and no matter what you do, there is always someone to help sort it out for you.

text: 当你贫穷落魄的时候，你就会发现曾经和你称兄道弟的人个个都离你而去。
en: When you are poor and down and out, you will discover that those who once called you brother have all left you.

text: 认识的人越多，我们就越明白，朋友不在于多，而在于真。
en: The more people we know, the more we understand that friends are not about quantity but about sincerity.

text: 以前，我们会因为一些遗憾的事情而耿耿于怀，终日郁郁寡欢。
en: Before, we would brood over regretful matters and be melancholy all day long.

text: 渐渐地，我们也放下了，人生没有十全十美，人这一辈子肯定会有许许多多的遗憾，不要让自己一辈子活在遗憾当中。
en: Gradually we have let go as well. Life is not perfect in every way; in this lifetime one is bound to have many regrets. Do not let yourself live a whole life trapped in regret.

text: 如今人到中年，我们的人生已经过去了大半，在我们未来的人生里，好好珍惜时间，享受生活，好好陪伴自己的家人，对于我们来说才是最重要的事情。
en: Now that we have reached middle age, our lives have already passed their greater part. In the life that remains to us, to treasure our time, enjoy life, and keep good company with our families is the most important thing for us.

text: 人生短暂，好好珍惜，过好自己的每一天。
en: Life is brief; treasure it well and live each of your days well.

text: 20岁的时候，我想出去看看这个世界。
en: At twenty, I wanted to go out and see the world.

text: 40岁的时候，我只想回到自己的出生地，安静地过完这一生。
en: At forty, I only want to return to my birthplace and live out the rest of my life in quiet.

text: 80年人，已经43了，用在年龄上是一个挺可怕的数字。
en: Born in 1980, I am already forty-three — a rather frightening figure when it comes to age.

text: 只是人生即将过半，智慧却没有增长，人生体会也不知从何谈起。
en: It is just that, with life nearly half over, my wisdom has not grown, and I know not where to begin speaking of life's lessons.

text: 有俩娃均是男孩，一个11岁一个6岁。
en: I have two children, both boys, one eleven and one six.

text: 去年勇气可嘉，竟然裸辞了老板留也不行。
en: Last year my courage was commendable — I actually quit without another job lined up, and even when the boss tried to keep me I would not stay.

text: 这个年纪裸辞就等于退休了。
en: At this age, quitting without a next job lined up is as good as retirement.

text: 目前经济尚可，老公还在上班，收入尚可，但是稳定性一般。
en: At present our finances are passable; my husband is still working and the income is acceptable, but its stability is only average.

text: 两套房，周围两个超便宜的小公寓，基本没有房贷，租金覆盖房贷有余，目前来看没有太多的经济压力，但是孩子还小，我们一直花钱大手大脚，未来需要花钱的地方太多，对于未来还是有些忐忑。
en: Two flats, plus two extremely cheap little apartments nearby; basically there is no mortgage, and the rent more than covers the mortgage with surplus. For now there is not too much financial pressure, but the children are still young, we have always spent money lavishly, and there will be far too many things to spend on in the future, so we still feel somewhat uneasy about what lies ahead.

text: 前几年在互联网太累了，只想躺着当废柴，躺了不到一个月就觉得无聊了，大娃去了寄宿学校，一个人每天在家刷手机刷的眼疼，家务也不太会做。
en: The past few years in internet work were too exhausting; I just wanted to lie down and be a good-for-nothing. After lying about for less than a month I found it boring. The elder child went to boarding school, and alone at home every day I scrolled my phone until my eyes ached, and I am not much good at housework either.

text: 当时想的养花写字，花是买了很多，不会养，字还没动过笔。
en: I had thought to keep flowers and take up writing; I bought many flowers but never learned to care for them, and have not yet put pen to paper.

text: 手机真是害人。
en: Mobile phones really are harmful.

text: 现在又想找个工作，朝九晚六的也不至于太无聊，发现太难了，没有企业会要个老人家。
en: Now I want to find a job again; even a nine-to-six one would not be too boring, but I find it far too difficult — no company will take on an old-timer.

text: 虽然觉得现在的状态非常好，经验人脉也是最丰富的时候，情绪稳定也有一点能力，但是就是没有人要，觉得人还是不能太作了，哈哈。
en: Although I feel my current state is very good, my experience and connections are at their richest, my emotions are steady and I have some ability, still no one wants me. I feel one really should not be too fussy, haha.

text: 82年、男、刚好40岁、1个男孩、10岁、
en: Born in 1982, male, just turned forty, one boy, ten years old.

text: 农村出来的孩子，适应能力很强也能吃苦，父母都在农村现在已是71岁和72岁，父母身体都不太好，家里的田和地也种不了啦，由于自己目前也没能力照顾到父母，父母那么大年纪还得靠自己双手生活，这几年父母一直在老家靠酿酒生活，由于是土法小灶酒一天也就只能酿几斤酒，过得也是艰苦！
en: A child from the countryside, I adapt well and can endure hardship. My parents are still in the village, now seventy-one and seventy-two. Both are in poor health and can no longer farm the fields. Since I am presently unable to care for them, my parents at such an age still have to rely on their own hands to live. These past few years they have been making a living back home by brewing liquor; because it is small-batch traditional brewing, they can only produce a few catties of liquor a day, and life is hard for them.

text: 由于家庭结构特殊，孩子一直都由我们自己带，老婆生孩子后就一直没有固定工作，主要做宝吗，偶尔做做兼职业务。
en: Because our family structure is unusual, we have always looked after the children ourselves. After my wife gave birth she has had no fixed job, mainly as a full-time mother, and occasionally doing some part-time work.

text: 近20年的工作经历，让我从小李变成了老李，说实话还真有些不大习惯！
en: Nearly twenty years of work have turned me from Little Li into Old Li; to be honest, it is rather hard to get used to!

text: 在家里自己排行老幺，有两个姐姐，从小到大我都是最小的，初入社会每到一家公司也是属于最年轻的那几个里面的，从事行业较多，近10几年都做地产营销行业，现在工作不稳定了，收入从以前的一万多到现在的3000工资真不知道自己是怎么走到这一步，想想自己已经中年了、没有事业没有存款，只有一堆的负责！
en: In my family I am the youngest, with two elder sisters; from childhood to adulthood I was always the smallest. When I first entered society, at every company I joined I was among the youngest. I have worked in many industries, and for the last ten-odd years in property marketing. Now my work is unstable, and my income has fallen from over ten thousand before to a salary of three thousand now — I truly do not know how I came to this point. Thinking that I am already middle-aged, with no career and no savings, only a pile of liabilities!

text: 现在的我迷茫没有方向，就像同龄朋友说一样职场真的不太欢迎中年人，企业也习惯性的把机会给年轻人，不知道什么样的工作适合我们中年人。
en: Presently I am confused and without direction. As a friend my own age said, the workplace really does not welcome middle-aged people, and companies habitually give opportunities to the young. I do not know what kind of work suits us middle-aged folk.

text: 真想多陪陪孩子，陪陪父母，不然孩子的童年就过去了，待我老去对于父母的遗憾也无法挽回了，我只想找出路，只想拼搏希望找些给家人一个安定的生活!
en: I truly wish to spend more time with my children and my parents, or else my children's childhood will pass by, and by the time I am old the regret over my parents will be beyond remedy. I only want to find a way out, only want to strive, hoping to find a stable life for my family!

text: 其实真的没有想到有这个问题，一看到题目心里就有一种难以抑制的感觉，说出来可能舒服点吧
en: I truly never expected this question; the moment I saw the topic a barely controllable feeling welled up inside me — perhaps it will feel better to speak it out.

text: 先做自我介绍：
en: First, a self-introduction:

text: 我82年，41岁，负债60万，两套房子价值110万，大型工作稳定，每月固定上班12天，休息18天。
en: I was born in 1982, forty-one years old, with six hundred thousand in debt and two houses worth one point one million. The work is on a large scale and stable: twelve fixed days at work each month and eighteen days off.

text: 年薪10万+，一辆像老友一样的老车，老婆已经内退，月入1000，独子一个6年级，无副业，党龄12年，月交党费80-100元不等，左小腿截肢已经10年，目前分居，交代完毕。
en: Annual salary over one hundred thousand, an old car like an old friend, my wife has taken early internal retirement, monthly income one thousand, one only son in sixth grade, no side business, twelve years' party membership, monthly party dues of eighty to one hundred yuan, left lower leg amputated for ten years, currently separated. That is all.

text: 截图不上单位名字，这个是上个月的考勤，月月都一样。
en: I will not show the employer's name in the screenshot; this is last month's attendance record, the same every month.

text: 开始感悟：
en: Reflections begin:

text: 1、年过40身体就像一道分界线，明显力不从心，尤其是我接受过大手术，很需要注意保养。
en: 1. Past forty, the body is like a dividing line; one clearly feels unable to cope as before, especially as I have undergone major surgery and must take great care to look after myself.

text: 2、工作没有进步的希望的时候，一定要培养自己的爱好的兴趣，比如写作。
en: 2. When there is no hope of progress at work, one must cultivate one's hobbies and interests, such as writing.

text: 3、创业的风险太大了，我12年创业开装修公司，赔的一塌糊涂。
en: 3. The risk of starting a business is too great. In 2012 I started up a decoration company and lost out spectacularly.

text: 4、凡事太聪明也不见得就有好结果，聪明反被聪明误，老祖宗诚不欺我。
en: 4. Being too clever in all matters does not necessarily bring good results; cleverness can be undone by cleverness itself. The ancestors truly did not deceive me.

text: 5、家庭关系一定要搞好，不然就像我一样，看是有家实则无家。
en: 5. Family relationships must be managed well, or else, like me, you will appear to have a home but in truth have none.

text: 6、明白了自作自受，对自己的以前的做为默默承受后果就好，没啥好抱怨的。
en: 6. I have understood that one reaps what one sows; just quietly bear the consequences of one's past actions — there is nothing to complain about.

text: 7、社会责任感在不断的降低，不是不想奉献，实在是有心无力。
en: 7. One's sense of social responsibility keeps diminishing; it is not that I do not wish to contribute, but simply that I have the will yet lack the power.

text: 8、幸福就像带着假牙吃肉，别人看着挺香，自己嚼着没味。
en: 8. Happiness is like eating meat with false teeth: others see it as tempting, but chewing it yourself, there is no taste.

text: 9、领导就像动物园的老虎，看着牛逼哄哄，其实只要你站在笼子外面，他就啥也不是。
en: 9. A leader is like a tiger in a zoo: he looks all impressive and puffed up, but in truth, so long as you stand outside the cage, he is nothing at all.

text: 10、朋友真的不能多，但是真的不能没有，能有三五个真朋友就算牛逼人物了。
en: 10. Friends really should not be too many, yet really cannot be absent; to have three or five true friends makes you quite a figure.

text: 11、除了直系亲属，别的靠山其实一点都不牢固。
en: 11. Apart from direct relatives, other backers are in fact not secure in the least.

text: 12、别熬夜，晚睡容易早死。
en: 12. Do not stay up late; going to bed late makes an early death likely.

text: 不过早睡也不见得就晚死。
en: Yet going to bed early does not necessarily mean a later death.

text: 13、万般皆是命，半点不由人，我们大多数人，都是靠运气活着，尤其是我这样的。
en: 13. All things are fate, not the slightest bit subject to man; most of us live by luck, especially someone like me.

text: 14、财去人安乐是可以接受的，财去人憋屈是难以接受的。
en: 14. Money gone yet the person at peace is acceptable; money gone yet the person wronged is hard to accept.

text: 15、那个向屎粑粑一样的牛皮糖，时刻粘在鞋底上，恶心又甩不掉的，就是自己年轻时的因果。
en: 15. That sticky sweet, like a lump of dung, forever clinging to the sole of the shoe, sickening and impossible to shake off — that is the karma of one's own youth.

text: 16、自创一文，沁园春·四十不惑。
en: 16. I composed a piece of my own: "Qinyuanchun·Forty Without Confusion."

text: 希望大家喜欢。
en: I hope everyone enjoys it.

text: 不惑之龄，薄衾孤枕，落木萧萧。
en: At the age of no confusion, with a thin quilt and a lonely pillow, the fallen leaves rustle desolately.

text: 忆过往人生，不乏虚度；学艺不精，见识浅薄。
en: Recalling the life gone by, not lacking in wasted years; my craft unrefined, my experience shallow.

text: 年少轻狂，自负大笑，以为自己非蓬蒿。
en: In youthful folly and arrogance, laughing in self-conceit, I thought myself no ordinary weed.

text: 更立志，必乘风破浪，功上云霄。
en: Further, I resolved that I must ride the wind and break the waves, my merit rising to the clouds.

text: 抬眼只看碧霄，妄图捷径一步登高。
en: I lifted my eyes to gaze only at the azure sky, vainly scheming for a shortcut to rise in a single step.

text: 叹实力不济，心比天高；不断撞墙，命比纸薄。
en: I sigh that my ability fell short, my heart higher than the heavens; constantly knocking against walls, my fate thinner than paper.

text: 九层之台，起于累土，合抱之木生末毫。
en: A nine-storey tower is built from piled earth; a tree that takes two arms to encircle grows from the tiniest sprout.

text: 才知道，欲得人生圆满，把握今朝。
en: Only then did I learn that to attain life's fulfilment, one must seize the present day.

text: 本人闲暇时间较多，诸位有啥靠谱的副业可以推荐一下给我吗？
en: I have rather a lot of spare time; could any of you recommend a reliable side business for me?

text: 那种卖教程教别人赚钱的就算了，我不喜欢骗人，一辈子到现在吃了太多过于诚实的亏，但是就是改不了。
en: Those who sell courses teaching others to make money — count me out. I do not like to deceive people; all my life up to now I have suffered too much for being overly honest, yet I simply cannot change.

text: 本人自认才疏学浅，但又常常妄自菲薄，所以需要大家多多关注，点赞收藏支持谢谢！
en: I consider myself lacking in talent and shallow in learning, yet I often undervalue myself, so I need everyone's attention, likes and favourites — thank you for your support!
